subject: E-1248: upload stalls on Android
body:
Good morning. My setup is SyncVault 4.2.5, Android 15 (Pixel 8). Whenever I start a sync since Monday, the app shows "E-1248: upload stalled at 0 bytes/s".

This started right after the app updated itself on Tuesday. The very same files synced in minutes before the update.

Before writing in I tried logging out of my browser; same error afterwards.

Aisha Bello - Meridian Schools. Appreciate any pointers.
